h2: Regular Pool Service Kerobokan & Umalas – Scheduled Care
intro: If your villa sits between Seminyak and Canggu, a Regular Pool Service Kerobokan & Umalas plan keeps water clear, pumps running, and garden drainage in check without you having to be on-site. After every visit you receive a WhatsApp report with photos, readings, and a summary of work done — handy when you're managing the property from abroad.

sections.h3: What Happens at Every Scheduled Visit
sections.text: We start by testing pH, chlorine, alkalinity and adjusting chemicals so the water stays safe for kids and guests. Then comes the physical work: vacuuming the floor, brushing walls, clearing the skimmer basket, and checking that the pump and filter are cycling properly. You get a short WhatsApp message with before-and-after photos, the day's readings, and anything we flagged. No paperwork, no chasing — just a quick scroll through your phone.

sections.h3: Why Kerobokan and Umalas Pools Work Harder
sections.text: The high groundwater table here means moisture seeps into pool surrounds faster than in drier parts of Bali, encouraging algae on tiles and stressing seals around the skimmer. Families living full-time in Kerobokan Kelod push heaters, pumps and backwash cycles harder than a weekend villa would. Add bigger gardens with irrigation lines and drainage channels, and small leaks go unnoticed until they show up as soggy patches near the rice-field boundary. Regular visits catch these shifts early.

sections.h3: Common Issues We See Around Umalas & Banjar Anyar
sections.text: Older villas next to new builds bring a mix of problems: corroded copper fittings from the original plumbing alongside cracked PVC joints from recent renovations. In Umalas, long-term tenants often notice pump hums changing pitch before a bearing actually fails. After heavy rain, septic-tank overflow can tint pool water greenish-brown if drains are blocked. We handle all of it — replacing worn O-rings, clearing clogged return jets, re-sealing tile grout, or tracing an irrigation leak under the garden path.

sections.h3: What to Send Us on WhatsApp (and Simple Prevention)
sections.text: A couple of photos of the pool surface, the pump area, and any visible staining is enough for us to quote a job — no need to describe it in detail. For day-to-day care, run the filter at least eight hours a day, keep the skimmer basket empty, and check that the backwash valve isn't stuck after a storm. If you're away for weeks, just message us a quick 'pool looks fine' or flag anything odd; we'll fold it into the next scheduled visit.

faq.q: How often should I book pool service in Kerobokan?
faq.a: Most villa owners here schedule visits every one to two weeks depending on usage and season. Families with kids or open-air pools tend toward weekly; weekend-use villas can stretch to fortnightly.

faq.q: Can I manage this entirely from abroad?
faq.a: Yes — you approve scope and receive the photo report over WhatsApp, so there's no need to be physically present. We handle scheduling around your availability and flag anything urgent immediately.

faq.q: How do I get a price for a specific repair?
faq.a: Send a few photos of the issue on WhatsApp and tell us what you've noticed; pricing depends on the job, and we'll come back with a clear quote before any work starts.
